name: Neon Trace
description: Glowing contour treatment that turns strong image edges into colored neon lines.
author: ozonerepublic74d77777

parameters.name: Edge Threshold
parameters.description: Sets the edge strength required to produce a neon contour.

parameters.name: Edge Scale
parameters.description: Controls the pixel spacing used to detect and soften contours.

parameters.name: Glow Spread
parameters.description: Controls the brightness and thickness of the neon treatment.

parameters.name: Neon Color
parameters.description: Sets the color used to draw the glowing contours.

parameters.name: Detail Gamma
parameters.description: Adjusts tonal sensitivity before edge detection.

parameters.name: Invert Mask
parameters.description: Reverses the contour mask when enabled for an experimental treatment.

parameters.name: Opacity
parameters.description: Controls the opacity of the neon contour layer.
